verdict.rationale: ImageMagick is a format-conversion tool, so document-conversion fidelity is a fair question, but nothing in the evidence shows it preserves layout, fonts, images or tables. Its documented scope is bitmap images ('Convert, Edit, or Compose Bitmap Images'; PNG, JPEG, WebP and similar), and a passing mention of a PDF coder does not show structure-preserving document conversion.

support.subject: As a power user, document conversion preserves layout, fonts, images, and tables rather than flattening them
